# Route recipe actual attempt

Use the Bug fix playbook under /poteto-mode. The frozen local playbook is present and was read.

```text
/poteto-mode Reproduce <symptom> in <app> before changing code, then fix the cause and rerun the same trigger under the same conditions. Use the project's verified app controls if available. Show the actual failing and passing actions, revision, output and side effects. If app controls are unavailable or the result is inconclusive, report that verification as blocked. Keep commits and external delivery pending my explicit authorization.
```
